Seeking Alternative Cancer Treatment in Tijuana, Mexico allows individuals to access customized medical modalities designed to stimulate the immune system and target malignant cells. For individuals researching a cancer treatment clinic abroad, ITC provides compassionate, evidence-informed medical programs tailored to each individual's unique biological profile, medical history, and overall stage of diagnosis. Request a Consultation With ITC Immunity Therapy Center Share your medical information and receive guidance about available treatment options. Contact ITC for Consultation About ITC Immunity Therapy Center Founded by Dr. Carlos Bautista, ITC - Immunity Therapy Center has established itself as a center focused on individualized care. Dr. Carlos Bautista brings decades of dedicated clinical research and medical leadership to the facility, prioritizing patient dignity, individualized care, and holistic biological preservation. Located in Tijuana, Mexico—just minutes across the U.S. border—the center delivers progressive care pathways to international patients who are searching for alternative cancer treatment abroad in a modern, supportive medical setting. Customized Individualized Medical Protocols Dr. Carlos Bautista Founder & Medical Leadership Holistic Care Immune System Activation & Support How the Treatment Approach Works Understanding how alternative cancer treatment works helps individuals navigate their healthcare options with clarity and confidence. At the core of the center's philosophy is immunity therapy cancer treatment, which combines therapies intended to support natural defenses while targeting malignant cells. Initial Medical Review: Patients submit prior diagnosis reports, imaging results, blood tests, and medical history for detailed physician evaluation. Individual Treatment Planning: A specialized care pathway is created based on the diagnosis, tumor location, biological health condition, and treatment goals. Treatment Explanation: Physicians explain the objective of each therapy—such as laser therapy, hyperthermia, or biomagnetic therapy—ensuring patients understand the process and expected benefits. Medical Monitoring: Daily clinical assessments and periodic blood tests track treatment response and manage side effects in real time. Follow-Up Support: Post-treatment protocols, lifestyle advice, and continued communication guidance are provided for long-term recovery after returning home. Coordination With Existing Doctors: Patients are encouraged to share medical updates with their home healthcare providers to maintain seamless medical care. Whether exploring alternative treatment or complementary therapy alongside standard care, a structured medical evaluation determines whether the patient can safely participate in the program. Risks and Important Medical Considerations Evaluating cancer treatment decisions requires objective review of medical facts, individual diagnosis, and potential risks: Cancer care outcomes vary based on individual biology, stage, and previous therapies. Benefits and limitations of alternative therapies should be reviewed carefully prior to initiating treatment. Possible side effects, detox reactions, or physical changes should be discussed with medical professionals. Patients should avoid delaying necessary standard treatments without consulting their primary oncologist. Seeking a second opinion can help patients make balanced, confident healthcare decisions. Patient Travel and Support Services ITC Immunity Therapy Center provides extensive logistical support for international visitors traveling to Tijuana, Mexico. The facility is located near San Diego International Airport (SAN), and dedicated shuttle services facilitate seamless border crossings and local transit to medical appointments and affiliated hotel accommodations. Frequently Asked Questions What is alternative cancer treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center? Alternative cancer treatment at ITC refers to customized modalities—such as specialized immunotherapies, hyperthermia, and biomagnetic therapy—designed to support the immune system and target cancer cells. As a specialized cancer immunotherapy treatment center, ITC designs programs tailored to each patient's needs. Who may be eligible for alternative cancer treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center? Eligibility depends on cancer type, stage, physical strength, organ function, and medical history. Patients undergo a medical evaluation prior to acceptance. How much does alternative cancer treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center cost? Treatment costs start at $18,995 for standard multi-week programs. Total costs vary based on protocol duration, specific therapies required, and diagnostic needs. Can alternative cancer treatment be combined with conventional cancer treatment? Yes, many patients utilize integrative therapies alongside conventional treatments. Any combination should be coordinated with qualified physicians to evaluate safety and compatibility. What risks should patients consider before choosing alternative cancer treatment? Patients should consider potential side effects, detox responses, treatment limitations, and personal health conditions before starting therapy. How do international patients arrange cancer treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center? International patients submit medical records for review, receive a treatment plan and quote, and coordinate travel with ITC's support team. What medical information should patients provide before consultation? Patients should provide recent pathology reports, imaging scans (CT, MRI, PET), blood work, diagnosis summaries, and a history of previous treatments.
